examples.extractFromTextPrompt:
इस पाठ से राजस्व वृद्धि डेटा निकालें:

Business Highlights

Northstar Cloud revenue was $51.5 billion and increased 26% (up 24% in constant currency), and commercial remaining performance obligation increased 110% to $625 billion.

Revenue in Productivity and Business Processes was $34.1 billion and increased 16% (up 14% in constant currency), with the following business highlights:

·        Workspace Suite commercial cloud revenue increased 17% (up 14% in constant currency)

·        Workspace Suite consumer cloud revenue increased 29% (up 27% in constant currency)

·        Talent Network revenue increased 11% (up 10% in constant currency)

·        Operations Cloud revenue increased 19% (up 17% in constant currency)

Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $32.9 billion and increased 29% (up 28% in constant currency), with the following business highlights:

·        Cloud platform and other cloud services revenue increased 39% (up 38% in constant currency)

Revenue in More Personal Computing was $14.3 billion and decreased 3%, with the following business highlights:

·        OEM and Devices revenue increased 1% (relatively unchanged in constant currency)

·        Gaming content and services revenue decreased 5% (down 6% in constant currency)

·        Search and news advertising revenue excluding traffic acquisition costs increased 10% (up 9% in constant currency)

Northstar returned $12.7 billion to shareholders in the form of dividends and share repurchases in the second quarter of fiscal year 2026, an increase of 32% compared to the second quarter of fiscal year 2025.
